summary: feat(shared): gate the WATCH prune and orphan cleanup behind a flag
description:
Because:
- Review asked to be able to switch back to the previous pruning
  quickly if the new code misbehaves in production.

This commit:
- Adds redis.sessionTokens.watchPrune (SESSIONS_REDIS_WATCH_PRUNE), on.
- Restores pruneSessionTokens_1 for the flag's off position.
- Skips the db.sessions orphan cleanup when the flag is off.
- Tests both positions, including the Lua prune against real Redis.

Closes FXA-14945
